generic_form.name: ObservationSpec
generic_form.rule: For PR9, an observation is a total deterministic map O:S->Y. Fibres, image, observational equivalence, injectivity, surjectivity and quotient structure are derived from the map rather than stored as independent truth.

records.name: Generic deterministic observation
nonclaims: O need not be injective or surjective.
O is not assumed linear, measurable, stochastic, physical, or ontologically privileged.

records.name: Constant two-state observation
nonclaims: This finite map is a logical fixture, not a model of a physical observer.

records.name: Uniform floor sampler family
records.domain: positive integers L,R with i in {0,...,R-1}
records.scope: exact finite sampling fixture for injective/surjective/fibre analysis
nonclaims: This sampling map is not the definition of observation in UFT-ID.
Sampling geometry does not confer truth or physical authority.
